report_scope: Saved scalar evidence only; no new scientific imports, array reads, PDE solves or selection

matched_comparison.cost_comparison: pS3 is the actual two-step p+p closure, +1848 fullFE; hx is one control closure, +1332 fullFE. This is a same-target/norm comparison, not an equal-DOF pair. The per-added-FE actual-gap ratio is a diagnostic, not the original projection policy objective.
matched_comparison.interpretation: Existing parent-local best-projection ranks agree across xyz. These actual PDE-solved candidate fields show a different question: hx has a lower x gap while pS3 has lower y,z and lower equal-weight gap to the same frozen targets. Neither is a true PDE-error or stability certificate. No acceptance change or target reweighting follows automatically.
matched_comparison.numerical_uncertainty: q15/q19 contrasts are observed diagnostics, not rigorous bounds; common-mode and frozen-target modeling error are not covered.

local_projection_rank.scope: Second-round per-axis rankings are conditional on the actual equal-weight first selection. They are not an independently executed x-only greedy trajectory. Observed uncertainty only; no PDE-error guarantee.

global_G_diagnostic.q19_semantics: same q15 minimizing coefficients directly sampled using original raised q19 rule; no second global factorization
